Dato live mostra MON, TUE, WED, THU, FRI: Live data shows MON, TUE, WED, THU, FRI, SAT or SUN; default preview MON. The native source remains numeric: 0=SUN, 1=MON, through 6=SAT.
Decimi Crono Pro: attivo = rotazione flu: Chrono Pro tenths: enabled = smooth rotation targeting 25 fps; disabled = ten steps per second. Stops at Stop and is excluded from AOD. Large chronograph seconds remain stepped.
Decimi del tempo misurato dal cronografo: Chrono Pro tenths: zero at rest, ten steps per second or smooth rotation targeting 25 fps when Smooth Motion is enabled in this tab. Frozen at the same Stop instant as POST and reset with a smooth sweep. Requires the large second hand's Chrono Pro flag in this style; large chronograph seconds remain stepped. Hiding the main-hand artwork does not disable Chrono Pro. Excluded from AOD.
Decimi, Centesimi e Millesimi appartengo: Tenths, Hundredths and Thousandths belong to small-hand sets. Remove these graphics before switching to a main-hand set.
Direzione del vento fornita dal meteo; d: Weather wind direction; separate from the compass sensor.
Direzione reale rilevata dalla bussola,: Real compass direction in degrees: 0° north, 90° east, 180° south, 270° west. The Analog compass rotates its rose by −360° to keep it pointing north.
Disattiva Genera ombre per rimuovere le: Disable Generate shadows to remove automatic shadows.
Disattivato in AOD: ore/minuti usano il: Disabled in AOD: hours/minutes use native behavior; seconds are excluded.
Dischi rotanti e sequenze grafiche del c: Rotating discs and calendar image sequences.
Disco a due lune: 59 posizioni, uno scat: Two-moon disc: 59 positions, one daily step of about 6.10°. Initial value 0 and range 59 are already set. At the reference date the moon is at the top at 0°; calibrate angle and direction for the dial window.
Disco a due lune: una posizione al giorn: Two-moon disc: one of 59 positions per day, independent of the chronograph. The reference date represents a full moon at the top; adjust days, initial angle and direction.
Disco lunare: modalità rotante, valori 0: Moon disc: rotation mode, values 0/59 and rotation ±360°.
Dopo il salvataggio torna su Quadrante e: After saving, return to Watchface and choose the set in the hour-hand menu: matching minute/second hands and shadows are paired automatically. You can change them separately afterward. For a small hand, choose a graphic in its menu. PNGs used by a watchface are embedded in the project; deleting or editing a set does not change saved projects.
Durata del movimento registrata dall’oro: Activity duration recorded by the watch.

Fascia oraria nella codifica nativa dell: Time of day in the watch's native encoding.
Fase lunare nativa, otto stati da New Mo: Native moon phase: eight states from New Moon to Waning Crescent. Live data shows the English name; use the Discs catalog for moon, sun and star graphics. The firmware supplies the value, without additional astronomical calculations.
Fasi lunari fornisce 8 stati (0–7), non: Moon phases provides eight states (0–7), not a running day count. For one revolution over eight states use initial value 0, range 8 and 360°. On a two-moon disc a cycle covers 180°. Choose Moon phases · 59 positions for a daily step.
Fasi lunari native: New Moon, Waxing Cre: Native moon phases: New Moon, Waxing Crescent, First Quarter, Waxing Gibbous, Full Moon, Waning Gibbous, Last Quarter, Waning Crescent. Preview: Full Moon. Use Discs for images.
Ferma durante Running. Allo Stop raggiun: Stationary while Running. At Stop it reaches the captured value in 720 ms at a 25 fps target. Accuracy depends on the firmware clock.
Frequenza cardiaca massima registrata, i: Maximum recorded heart rate, in beats per minute.
Frequenza cardiaca minima registrata, in: Minimum recorded heart rate, in beats per minute.
Giorni in inglese: MON, TUE, WED, THU, F: English weekdays: MON, TUE, WED, THU, FRI, SAT, SUN. Default preview: MON.
Giorno del calendario lunare: 1–29/30, p: Lunar calendar day: 1–29/30, then returns to 1. Changes daily but is not a continuous 0–58 counter for a 59-position moon wheel.
Giorno lunare: valori 1–29/30, uno al gi: Lunar day: 1–29/30, advancing daily then returning to 1. Range 59 and rotation 360° create steps of about 6.10°, but the monthly return to 1 prevents a continuous 59-day cycle. Choose Moon phases · 59 positions for continuous progression.
Giro completo disponibile: 360°, oppure: Full revolution available: 360°, or −360° for counterclockwise. Range 100/1000 for complete POST fractions; 10 for a single digit.
Il flag agisce sulla sorgente della lanc: The flag applies to compatible small-hand sources. Chrono Pro hours, minutes and seconds advance in steps; return sweeps remain smooth.
Il giorno non esiste nel mese e anno sim: This day does not exist in the simulated month and year. Choose a valid date.
Il livello nuovo mostra soltanto il valo: A new layer shows only the value. You can enable optional decorations here.
Il modello ore abbina automaticamente mi: The hour model automatically pairs matching minute and second hands. Each hand can be changed afterward. Every graphic keeps its own shadow and color.
Il perno automatico segue l’estremità vi: The automatic pivot follows the visible end. Editing a manual pivot disables this option.
Il pivot automatico segue la lancetta. R: The automatic pivot follows the hand. Adjust the offset in Generate shadows settings.
Il pivot dell’ombra automatica segue il: The generated shadow pivot follows the disc.

Lettura POST del Crono Pro: frazione del: Chrono Pro POST readout: complete second fraction 00–99 or a single hundredths digit 0–9. Stays at zero during Running and reaches the captured Stop value with a 720 ms, 25 fps target animation. Actual resolution depends on the available firmware clock. Excluded from AOD.

Chrono Pro POST readout: complete second fraction 000–999 or a single thousandths digit 0–9. All hands share the same Stop instant; no fast updates during Running. Firmware animation-phase timing does not guarantee 1 ms accuracy. Excluded from AOD.
L’ora intera in formato 24 ore. Alle 14:: Whole hour in 24-hour format. At 14:37 the value is 14. A small-hour dial with 24 values and 720° makes two turns per day.
